messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Quality regression detected for tenant 'AcmeCorp' (dedicated-pool eu-west-1). Metric: generation_similarity_score down 32% vs baseline. Affected model: redwood-gpt-large-quant-v2. Triggered at 2026-03-14T05:12:39Z
oncall-ai: pinging oncall. I'm the ai oncall for this shift, grabbing initial triage.
sre_anna: I can join for infra checks. Any signs of GPU OOMs or node reboots?
ml_ops_jordan: I rolled a quant profile change (profile: qprofile-2026-03-14-v3) for a subset of tenants ~05:11 UTC as part of the scheduled rollout. AcmeCorp was in the early target group.
oncall-ai: ok that timing aligns. Can you confirm the exact config that was pushed to their tenant?
ml_ops_jordan: Config pushed: `quant_profile: qprofile-2026-03-14-v3`, `bitwidth: 4`, `per_channel: true`, `fallback_model: redwood-gpt-large-fp16` (note: fallback not auto-routed, requires routing rule).
oncall-ai: Dedicated-ops, can we isolate their traffic and route to fallback model? We want to avoid cross-tenant noise.
dedicated-ops: we have tenant routing rules. We can create a temporary route to `redwood-gpt-large-fp16` at the pool level for AcmeCorp. Will need ~10m to apply and drain current sessions.
solutions_sam: Customer success — Acme reports a spike in hallucinations starting 05:14 UTC. They can be paged; but we should prepare a short blurb first.
eng_ryan: I'll prepare a fast revert once we confirm this is the quant profile. Jordan, can you reproduce locally with the same profile? If yes, plan: revert-to-qprofile-previous, or route to fp16 fallback. Which is lower-risk?
ml_ops_jordan: I can repro in a sandbox with the same model + qprofile in ~15m. Reverting the rollout (restore qprofile-2026-03-01-v1) is quicker at control plane level but needs a deploy to the tenant config. Routing to fp16 is non-invasive but may change latency/cost.
oncall-ai: Customer impact: prod responses mismatch for generation tests. Need immediate mitigation to stop customer-facing regressions. Prioritise routing to fallback model, then revert profile as permanent fix.
sre_anna: Infrastructure check done: no node reboots, no GPU memory errors. Network and IO fine. Latency slightly higher on fallback candidate but acceptable.
dedicated-ops: Starting tenant route change now: creating route rule `route-acmecorp-fallback-1769509999`. Will `kubectl apply` then resume.
eng_ryan: Command I'll run after ops confirm: ```bash
# pin tenant to fallback model
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/tenants/acmecorp/route \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-large-fp16","route_reason":"emergency-fallback-1769509999"}'
```
dedicated-ops: Route applied, sessions draining (est 2-3 minutes). Redirects begin at 05:25:10 UTC.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager escalation to oncall-ai (acknowledged at 2026-03-14T05:20:01Z). Incident severity: P2 (customer impact, single tenant).
customer-success-liaison: I'll draft a short message: "We're seeing degraded output quality for some requests. We're routing your traffic to a fallback model to restore quality and will follow up with a technical root cause and timeline." Want approval before sending.
oncall-ai: Go ahead and send once routing shows >90% traffic on fallback. Keep message high-level, no config details.
ml_ops_jordan: Sandbox repro shows same drop in BLEU/semantic similarity when qprofile-v3 applied. Suspect quantization induced miscalibration in layernorm ops — we saw similar pattern in canary last quarter.
eng_ryan: Once routing is stable, I'll trigger a revert to qprofile-2026-03-01-v1 for AcmeCorp and roll the qprofile rollout back for the fleet. Revert command: `PATCH /model-configs/acmecorp` with previous profile.
dedicated-ops: Traffic on fallback now 94% (05:27:18 UTC). Error rate for generation requests down to baseline.
customer-success-liaison: Sent message to AcmeCorp support contact: "Routing applied; you should see improvement now. We're investigating and will update within 2 hours." (:+1:)
oncall-ai: Great. eng_ryan, proceed with revert when ready. Jordan, open a regression ticket and attach repro artifacts.
ml_ops_jordan: Created ticket: JIRA-INC-4312. Attached logs, sample prompts, outputs, quant profile diffs.
eng_ryan: Revert applied at 05:33:55 UTC: `qprofile: qprofile-2026-03-01-v1` pinned for tenant AcmeCorp. Control plane returned 200. Will monitor.
sre_anna: Observability: generation_similarity_score returned to +1% of baseline at 05:38 UTC. Latency stable. No collateral impact observed on other tenants.
incident-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Postmortem owner needed. Assigning to ml_ops_jordan by default. Please update within 48h.
ml_ops_jordan: I'll own the postmortem and run a deeper audit of the qprofile testing harness. Preliminary hypothesis: rollout gating missed a semantic-similarity regression due to insufficient prompt diversity in canary.
solutions_sam: Customer follow-up plan: technical summary + timeline + ask if they'd like a dedicated review call.
customer-success-liaison: AcmeCorp acknowledged and thanked us for the quick rollback. They requested the postmortem once ready.
oncall-ai: Handoff note for night oncall: issue resolved, routing reverted, monitoring in steady state. Keep watch on any regression alerts for AcmeCorp.
eng_ryan: Adding runbook update: ensure rollback path for quant_profile changes and an automated route-to-fallback option in control plane (ticket: INFRA-7890).
ml_ops_jordan: I'll add additional semantic similarity tests to the canary suite and block qprofile rollouts that fail those.
incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-ai at 2026-03-14T05:48:22Z — status: mitigated; postmortem pending.
